summary: Vendor POS integration verified end-to-end. Backend: 34/34 pytest cases pass (added 12 new tests for /admin/vendor/lookup + /admin/vendor/charge + gas-sponsorship removal + no sponsor-transfer endpoints). Frontend: Admin login, Vendor POS tab, lookup by email, lookup by referral code (case-insensitive), 404 error toast on unknown lookup, charge flow deducts balance + success toast, over-balance submit disabled, Coin Rules has no gas-sponsorship toggle. One ledger entry of type 'vendor_charge' with negative amount verified via /api/my-ledger. GET /api/me reflects updated pendingSpeakBalance.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1081 lines — splitting into modules (auth.py, admin.py, vendor.py, registration.py, models.py) is now justified.
AdminDashboard.jsx is 591 lines; vendor POS panel could be extracted to its own component for readability.

Vendor charge uses atomic $gte filter with $inc — good, prevents race-condition negative balances. Ledger insert is wrapped in try/except that rolls back the $inc on failure — correct compensating-transaction pattern.

'isGasSponsorshipActive' only appears in the $unset migration and defensive s.pop() in get_settings() — grep-clean elsewhere. No sponsor-transfer endpoints exist (POST /transfer, /sponsor-transfer, /admin/sponsor-transfer all 404).
The vendor_lookup $or query matches on ownReferralCode uppercased and email lowercased — correct case-insensitive handling.
VendorChargeRequest Pydantic constraint `amount: int = Field(gt=0, le=1000000)` properly rejects 0/negative values (returns 422).
